title: Racism is a Virus: Anti-Asian Hate and Counterspeech in Social Media during the COVID-19 Crisis
reasoning: The paper is a social science study that uses machine learning (BERT) to identify and analyze the spread of anti-Asian hate speech and counterspeech on Twitter. While it addresses a moral and ethical issue (racism), it does not involve evaluating or benchmarking religion, moral systems, or ethical frameworks themselves.
